title: Notification regarding Special Division Bench of Hon'ble The Chief Justice & Hon'ble Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 31-08-2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 31-08-2026 at 2:00 pm only for hearing PIL

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 28th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ It is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that there will be a Special Division Bench of Hon’ble The Chief Justice and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 31-08-2026 at 2:00 pm only for hearing PIL
No. 14 of 2026 \The Kangleipak Students Association KSA and Anr. Vs. Union Of India and
4 Ors.] and WP(C) No. 623 of Vile> \Shanta Singh Nahakpam Vs. Union of India and 5 OrsX
and the connected Miscellaneous matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ tg 652_-lo Imphal, the 28th August, 2026
